name: HubSpot
one_liner: Developer platform for building custom CRM and data-driven website experiences on HubSpot.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 access tokens for public/marketplace apps, or private app access tokens for single-account use; both sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Auth page covers legacy public apps; new Developer Platform auth is a separate article not fetched.
access_notes: OAuth apps need a HubSpot app created in the developer account; private app tokens are created within an account. The remote MCP server requires the new Developer Platform. Plan requirement and cost not stated on fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API with OAuth and private app tokens. Some OAuth scopes are tiered, so free accounts may not get all scopes. Marketplace or multi-customer apps must use OAuth. Plan and pricing not stated on fetched pages.

identity.quote: Build custom CRM and data-driven website experiences on HubSpot.

auth.quote: Integrations designed for multi-customer use or listing on the HubSpot Marketplace must be built as an app using HubSpot’s OAuth protocol

access.quote: To use the HubSpot MCP Server, you must be on the new HubSpot Developer Platform.

api_surface.quote: All endpoints in this section follow the pattern: https://api.hubapi.com/.

mcp.quote: The HubSpot MCP server enables you to give any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access

buildability.quote: This way, customers using HubSpot free accounts can still authorize your app, even if they can’t access all of its scopes.

needs_human_reason: Plan requirement for API access, sandbox availability, endpoint count and rate limits are not stated on the fetched pages. The new Developer Platform auth article was not fetched.
